adds.title: Daredevil S2#3
adds.text: Foggy finds Claire at Metro-General and asks about the missing Matt. She has him help with a patient, then checks the city's hospital records for Matt and tells him Matt can take care of himself.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: The nurse who checks hospital records for the missing Matt.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Matt's best friend, who comes to Claire looking for him.
adds.evidence: In New York's Finest (Daredevil S2#3), Foggy visits Claire at Metro-General asking if she has seen Matt; she has him help calm a wounded patient, checks hospital records (Matt was not treated anywhere) and reassures him. They meet again in S2#11 in the hospital elevator when she has quit.
